subject.title: Preserve Open WebUI UUID sessions across Control UI

question: Should maintainers keep this PR as the UUID session fix after splitting out the Codex/provider transport changes, or retarget the work to the broader raw-alias session contract?
rationale: The remaining blocker is a maintainer boundary choice: session aliases affect persisted state, while the branch also introduces unrelated provider/auth transport behavior that should not be accepted accidentally.

options.title: Split and narrow this PR
options.body: Keep only the Open WebUI UUID session identity repair, rebase it onto the current session-accessor code, and require real Open WebUI plus Control UI proof before merge.

options.title: Retarget to raw-alias work
options.body: Preserve useful UUID tests but move the fix into the broader raw external alias implementation if maintainers want one shared alias contract.

options.title: Close and replace
options.body: Close this stale branch after opening or selecting a narrower replacement that does not carry unrelated Codex/provider runtime changes.

recommendation.title: Split and narrow this PR
recommendation.body: Keep only the Open WebUI UUID session identity repair, rebase it onto the current session-accessor code, and require real Open WebUI plus Control UI proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The session storage boundary, Control UI route state, and provider runtime history point to steipete as the best available owner for this merge-risk decision.
